title: Parking tickets 2014-2016
description:
The City of Vancouver regulates parking to balance the needs of residents, commuters, and visitors. This dataset includes parking ticket records data available from Parking Operations and Enforcement branch, from year 2014 to 2016

Due to platform limitation, records from other years need to split into multiple datasets. See other parking tickets datasets for data starting from 2010.

Notes:

  • This dataset also includes water tickets that are issued by the branch starting in 2015
  • This dataset does not include parking tickets issued by Vancouver Police Department
  • Ticket issued location information was aggregated to 100-block unit level.​
  • Testing in production may result in test record
  • Effective April 30, 2018, data files starting from year 2011 have been updated to reflect change in new software platform.​​

Data currency

The data for past years is static.

Data accuracy

Data is based on infraction occurred date and does not show current status of a parking ticket or changes after the ticket is originally issued.
